content.title: NTN 6203 Deep Groove Ball Bearing - 17mm Bore x 40mm OD x 12mm Width
content.short_description: NTN 6203 single-row deep groove ball bearing with 17 mm bore, 40 mm outer diameter, and 12 mm width. Dynamic load rating 9.7 kN, static load rating 4.75 kN.
content.long_description:
The NTN 6203 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized to a 17 mm bore, 40 mm outer diameter, and 12 mm width, matching standard 6203-series envelope dimensions used across general industrial rotating equipment.

Load capacity is rated at 9.7 kN dynamic (C) and 4.75 kN static (C0), figures used to calculate expected service life under radial and light axial loading. Maximum operating temperature is specified at 120 C, which should be checked against the thermal conditions of the application, including housing fit, speed, and lubricant limits.

As a deep groove design, the 6203 accommodates combined radial and moderate axial loads in both directions, making it suitable for shaft-mounted rotating assemblies where a compact 17/40/12 mm envelope is required. Confirm shaft and housing tolerances, seal or shield configuration, and lubrication type against your equipment specification before installation, as these details are not included in the attributes listed here.

This bearing is cataloged under Rolling Element Bearings within Bearings & Power Transmission. Use the MPN 6203 to cross-reference against equivalent ABEC/ISO 15-series metric ball bearings when sourcing replacements.
